en.s: The siege of Lisbon, from 1 July to 25 October 1147, was the military action against the Almoravid dynasty that brought the city of Lisbon under the definitive control of the new Christian power, the Kingdom of Portugal. The siege of Lisbon was one of the few Christian victories of the Second Crusade—it was "the only success of the universal operation undertaken by the pilgrim army", i.e., the Second Crusade, according to the near contemporary historian Helmold, although others have questioned whether it was really part of that crusade.

zh.s: 里斯本围城战发生于1147年7月1日至10月25日，是一场针对阿尔摩拉维王朝的军事行动，最终使葡萄牙王国这一新兴基督教政权稳固控制里斯本。里斯本围城战是第二次十字军东征中为数不多的基督教胜利之一。接近同时代的历史学家赫尔莫尔德称，这是“朝圣军队发起的普世行动中唯一的成功”，也就是第二次十字军东征的唯一成功，但后来有学者质疑这场围城战是否真的属于东征。

en.t: Seljuk Turks defeat German crusaders under Conrad III at the Battle of Dorylaeum
en.s: The second Battle of Dorylaeum took place near Dorylaeum in October 1147 during the Second Crusade. The battle consisted of a series of encounters over several days. The German Crusader forces of Conrad III were defeated by the Seljuk Turks led by Sultan Mesud I.

zh.t: 塞尔柱突厥人在多里莱乌姆之战中击败康拉德三世率领的德意志十字军
zh.s: 第二次多里莱乌姆之战于1147年10月在第二次十字军东征期间发生于多里莱乌姆附近。战斗由持续数日的一系列交锋组成。康拉德三世率领的德意志十字军被塞尔柱突厥人击败，塞尔柱军队由苏丹马苏德一世指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Llucmajor (Catalan: Batalla de Llucmajor; IPA: [bəˈtaʎə ðə ˌʎumːəˈʒo]) occurred in 1349 when Peter IV of Aragon's forces defeated and killed his cousin James III of Majorca in the town of Llucmajor on the Balearic Islands, resulting in the end of the independent Kingdom of Majorca.

zh.s: 卢克马约尔之战（加泰罗尼亚语：Batalla de Llucmajor；国际音标：[bəˈtaʎə ðə ˌʎumːəˈʒo]）发生于1349年。阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世的军队在巴利阿里群岛的卢克马约尔镇击败并杀死了他的表亲、马略卡国王海梅三世，独立的马略卡王国由此终结。

en.s: The siege of Setenil was military engagement between the Castilians and the Moors of Granada. The Castilians besieged the town of Setenil, near Ronda. The siege lasted for 20 days and ended in failure for Castile.

en.s: The Battle of Agincourt (/ˈæʒɪnkʊr/; in French, Azincourt French pronunciation: ​[azɛ̃kuʁ]) was a major English victory in the Hundred Years' War. The battle took place on Friday, 25 October 1415 (Saint Crispin's Day), near Azincourt, in northern France. Henry V's victory at Agincourt, against a numerically superior French army, crippled France and started a new period in the war during which Henry V married the French king's daughter, and their son, later Henry VI of England and Henry II of France, was made heir to the throne of France as well as of England.

zh.s: 阿金库尔战役是百年战争期间英格兰的一场重大胜利。战役于1415年10月25日星期五（圣克里斯平日）在法国北部阿金库尔附近进行。英王亨利五世以少胜多，重创法国，并使战争进入新阶段。此后，亨利五世迎娶法国国王的女儿，他们的儿子后来成为英格兰国王亨利六世和法国国王亨利二世，并被立为英格兰和法国王位继承人。

en.s: The Siege of Lingen took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War by a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange. Frederik van den Bergh defended Lingen for Philip II of Spain which was besieged from 25 October 1597. After a siege of more than two weeks, Van den Bergh surrendered on 12 November 1597.

zh.s: 林根围城战发生在八十年战争和英西战争期间，由奥兰治的莫里斯率领的荷兰和英国联军围攻。西班牙国王腓力二世的守军由弗雷德里克·范登贝赫指挥。围城始于1597年10月25日；两个多星期后，范登贝赫于1597年11月12日投降。

en.s: The Battle of Elmina was a military engagement of the Dutch-Portuguese War, fought near the castle of São Jorge da Mina (Elmina Castle) in the Portuguese Gold Coast in 1625. It was fought between 1,200 soldiers of the Dutch West India Company (transported by a fleet of 15 ships) who landed and assaulted the Portuguese garrison of the castle.

zh.s: 埃尔米纳之战是荷兰—葡萄牙战争中的一场军事冲突，于1625年在葡萄牙黄金海岸圣若热达米纳城堡（埃尔米纳城堡）附近爆发。荷兰西印度公司派出15艘船运送1,200名士兵登陆，并向城堡内的葡萄牙驻军发起进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Meelick Island took place on Meelick Island in the River Shannon, on the border between Connacht and Leinster in Ireland on 25 October 1650. It was fought between the Irish Confederates and the English Parliamentarians during the Irish Confederate Wars. The battle occurred when an English force under Colonel Daniel Axtell attacked the Connacht Irish army led by Ulick Burke, 1st Marquess of Clanricarde.

zh.s: 米利克岛战役于1650年10月25日在爱尔兰香农河的米利克岛发生，岛屿位于康诺特和伦斯特交界处。交战双方是爱尔兰邦联战争期间的爱尔兰邦联军和英国议会军。丹尼尔·阿克斯特尔上校率领英军袭击了由克兰里卡德侯爵乌利克·伯克领导的康诺特爱尔兰军队，由此爆发战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Praga took place on October 25, 1705 near the town of Warsaw, Poland during the fifth year of the Great Northern War. The Swedish army of more than 270 men assisted by approximately 140 soldiers from the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth under the command of Valentin Dahldorf defeated a combined Polish–Saxon–Russian force of about 5,000 men under Michał Serwacy Wiśniowiecki and Aleksandr Menshikov.

zh.s: 普拉加战役于1705年10月25日在波兰华沙附近进行，当时大北方战争进入第五年。瓦伦丁·达尔多夫指挥的瑞典军队有270多人，并得到波兰立陶宛联邦约140名士兵协助，击败了约5,000人的波兰—萨克森—俄罗斯联军。联军由米哈乌·谢尔瓦齐·维希尼奥维茨基和亚历山大·缅什科夫指挥。

en.s: The second battle of Cape Finisterre was a naval encounter fought during the War of the Austrian Succession on 25 October 1747. A British fleet of fourteen ships of the line commanded by Rear-Admiral Edward Hawke intercepted a French convoy of 250 merchant ships, sailing from the Basque Roads in western France to the West Indies and protected by eight ships of the line commanded by Vice Admiral Henri-François des Herbiers.

zh.t: 第二次菲尼斯特雷角海战
zh.s: 第二次菲尼斯特雷角海战是奥地利王位继承战争期间于1747年10月25日发生的一场海战。爱德华·霍克少将指挥的14艘英国战列舰拦截了一支由250艘商船组成的法国船队。法国船队从法国西部的巴斯克路出发，驶往西印度群岛，由亨利-弗朗索瓦·德·埃尔比耶中将指挥的8艘战列舰护航。

en.s: The Battle of Tearcoat Swamp was a battle during the American Revolutionary War between Lieutenant Colonel Francis Marion's Patriot militia, and a Loyalist Militia led by Lieutenant Colonel Samuel Tynes. The battle took place on 25 October 1780 in present-day Clarendon County, South Carolina.

zh.s: 蒂尔科特沼泽战役是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗，交战双方是弗朗西斯·马里恩中校率领的爱国者民兵，以及塞缪尔·泰恩斯中校领导的保王派民兵。战役于1780年10月25日在今南卡罗来纳州克拉伦登县发生。

en.s: The Battle of Johnstown was fought in Johnstown, New York. It was one of the last battles in the Northern theatre of the American Revolutionary War, with approximately 1400 engaged at Johnstown on October 25, 1781. Local American forces, led by Colonel Marinus Willett of Johnstown, ultimately put the British forces under the command of Major John Ross of the King's Royal Regiment of New York and Captain Walter Butler of Butler's Rangers to flight. This was the first time so many British regular army troops participated in a border raid in this area.

zh.s: 约翰斯敦战役在纽约州约翰斯敦进行，是美国独立战争北方战区最后几场战役之一。1781年10月25日，约1,400人参战。当地美军由约翰斯敦的马里努斯·威利特上校率领，最终击退了英军。英军由纽约国王皇家军团少校约翰·罗斯和巴特勒游骑兵队长沃尔特·巴特勒指挥。这是当地边境袭击中首次有如此多英国正规军参加。

en.s: The cutting out of the Hermione (also known as the capture of Hermione) was a naval action that took place at Puerto Cabello, Venezuela on 25 October 1799. The formerly British frigate HMS Hermione, which had been handed over to the Spanish by its crew following a vicious mutiny, lay in the heavily guarded sea port of Puerto Cabello, now under the command of Captain Ramón Echalaz.

zh.s: “赫敏”号夺取行动又称“夺取赫敏号”，于1799年10月25日在委内瑞拉卡贝略港发生，是一场海战。原英国皇家海军“赫敏”号护卫舰的船员曾发动激烈叛变，随后将舰艇交给西班牙。事发时，这艘护卫舰停泊在戒备森严的卡贝略港，舰长为拉蒙·埃查拉斯。

en.s: USS Enterprise vs Flambeau was a single ship action fought in October 1800 during the Quasi-War, and the final battle between French and American forces. During the action, USS Enterprise defeated the French brig Flambeau off the leeward side of the island of Dominica in the Caribbean Sea. Although Enterprise was outgunned by Flambeau, she was still able to take her as a prize after a short battle.

zh.t: 美国海军“企业”号与“火炬”号交战
zh.s: 美国海军“企业”号与法国双桅横帆船“火炬”号于1800年10月在准战争期间进行了一场单舰交战，也是法美军队之间的最后一场战斗。“企业”号在加勒比海多米尼克岛背风侧击败了“火炬”号。尽管“企业”号火力不及对手，但仍在短暂交战后将其俘获。

en.s: The Battle of Poona took place on 25 October 1802 near Pune between the rival factions of the Maratha Confederacy. The forces of the Scindia (Shinde) and the Peshwa Bajirao II were attacked by the Holkars. While the British East India Company was not involved in the battle, its outcome and aftermath led to the Second Anglo-Maratha War. In May 1802, Maharaja Yashwantrao Holkar marched towards Pune to solve the disputes. He conquered Sendhwa, Chalisgaon, Dhulia, Malegaon, Parol, Ner, Ahmednagar, Rahuri, Nashik, Sinnar, Dungargaon, Jamgaon, Pharabagh, Gardond, Pandharpur, Kurkumb, Narayangaon, Baramati, Purandhar, Saswad, Moreshwar, Thalner, and Jejuri.

zh.s: 浦那战役于1802年10月25日在浦那附近爆发，交战双方是马拉塔联盟中的敌对派系。辛迪亚（辛德）和佩什瓦·巴吉拉奥二世的军队遭到霍尔卡尔家族军队袭击。英国东印度公司没有参与战斗，但战斗结果及其后续影响引发了第二次英马拉塔战争。1802年5月，雅什万特拉奥·霍尔卡尔王公为解决争端，率军向浦那进发。他先后征服森德瓦、查利斯冈、杜利亚、马莱冈、帕罗尔、内尔、艾哈迈德讷格尔、拉胡里、纳西克、西纳尔、东加尔冈、贾姆冈、法拉巴格、加尔东德、潘达尔普尔、库尔昆布、纳拉扬冈、巴拉马蒂、普兰达尔、萨斯瓦德、莫雷什瓦尔、塔尔内尔和杰朱里。

en.s: The Battle of Maguelone was a naval engagement which occurred on 25 October 1809 during the Peninsular War between a French Imperial Navy squadron of three ships of the line and two frigates and a six-ship squadron of the British Royal Navy. In a running battle, the French squadron covered the retreat of a convoy they were escorting and attempted to escape from the British by sailing in shallow waters close to the shore of Villeneuve-lès-Maguelone.

zh.s: 马古洛讷海战是半岛战争期间于1809年10月25日发生的一场海战。法国帝国海军的一支分舰队由3艘战列舰和2艘护卫舰组成，英国皇家海军一支由6艘舰艇组成的分舰队与之交战。战斗过程中，法军掩护其护送的船队撤退，并试图沿维勒讷沃莱马古洛讷附近的浅水海岸逃离英军。

en.s: The Battle of Saguntum on 25 October 1811 saw the French Army of Aragon under Marshal Louis Gabriel Suchet fighting a Spanish army led by Lieutenant General Joaquín Blake y Joyes. The Spanish attempt to raise the siege of the castle of Sagunto (Saguntum) failed when the French, Italians, and Poles drove their troops off the battlefield in rout. The action took place during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. The city lies a short distance from the east coast of Spain, about 30 kilometres (19 mi) north of Valencia. Suchet invaded the province of Valencia in September 1811.

zh.s: 萨贡托战役于1811年10月25日爆发。法国阿拉贡军团在元帅路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇指挥下，与若阿金·布莱克·伊·霍伊斯中将率领的西班牙军队交战。西班牙军队试图解围萨贡托城堡，但未能成功；法国、意大利和波兰军队将其击溃并赶下战场。战斗发生在拿破仑战争中的半岛战争期间。萨贡托位于西班牙东海岸附近，距瓦伦西亚以北约30公里（19英里）。絮歇于1811年9月入侵瓦伦西亚省。

en.t: USS United States vs HMS Macedonian
en.s: The capture of HMS Macedonian was a naval action fought near Madeira on 25 October 1812 between the heavy frigate USS United States, commanded by Stephen Decatur, and the frigate HMS Macedonian, under the command of John Surman Carden. The American vessel won the long bloody battle, capturing and bringing Macedonian back to the United States. It was the first British warship to ever be brought into an American harbor.

zh.s: “马其顿”号被俘事件于1812年10月25日在马德拉附近发生，是一场海战。斯蒂芬·迪凯特指挥的美国重型护卫舰“合众国”号与约翰·瑟曼·卡登指挥的英国皇家海军“马其顿”号交战。美舰在一场漫长而惨烈的战斗中获胜，将英舰俘获并带回美国。这是第一艘被带入美国港口的英国军舰。

en.s: The action of Tambo Nuevo, also known as Hazaña de los Tres Sargentos, was a successful cavalry raid carried out between 23 and 25 October 1813, during the second Upper Peru campaign of the Argentine War of Independence, by a small detachment of dragoons of the Army of the North. The targets were the headquarters of royalist Colonel Saturnino Castro at Yocalla, and later a forward outpost on Tambo Nuevo.

zh.s: 坦博努埃沃突袭又称“三名中士的壮举”，是阿根廷独立战争第二次上秘鲁战役期间的一次成功骑兵突袭，于1813年10月23日至25日由北方军一支小型龙骑兵分队实施。目标包括位于约卡利亚、由保王党萨图尔尼诺·卡斯特罗上校设立的总部，以及之后的一处坦博努埃沃前哨。

en.s: The Battle of Saltillo (October 25, 1840) was fought between insurgents under the command of Colonel Samuel Jordan fighting for the Republic of the Rio Grande and the Centeralists under the command of General Rafael Vasquez fighting for the First Mexican Republic. zh.s: 萨尔蒂约战役于1840年10月25日爆发。萨缪尔·乔丹上校指挥的起义军为里奥格兰德共和国而战，与拉斐尔·巴斯克斯将军指挥的中央集权派交战，后者效忠墨西哥第一共和国。战斗以中央集权派获胜告终。

en.s: Malespín's War (Spanish: Guerra de Malespín) was a Salvadoran and Honduran invasion of Nicaragua caused by the election of liberal democrat Manuel Pérez at the time of Central American turmoil dictated by Rafael Carrera's conservative dictatorship in Guatemala. The war mostly took place in León, which was besieged by the invading forces on 27 November 1844, a siege which would last until 24 January 1845.

zh.s: 马莱斯平战争（西班牙语：Guerra de Malespín）是萨尔瓦多和洪都拉斯入侵尼加拉瓜的一场战争。起因是自由派民主人士曼努埃尔·佩雷斯当选总统，当时中美洲局势受危地马拉保守派独裁者拉斐尔·卡雷拉左右。战事主要发生在莱昂。1844年11月27日，入侵部队围攻该城，围城持续至1845年1月24日。

en.s: The Battle of Balaclava, fought on 25 October 1854 during the Crimean War, was part of the Siege of Sevastopol (1854–55), an attempt by the British, French and Ottoman allies to capture the port and fortress of Sevastopol, Russia's principal naval base on the Black Sea. The engagement followed the earlier Allied victory in September at the Battle of the Alma, where the Russian General Menshikov had positioned his army in an attempt to stop the Allies progressing south towards their strategic goal.

zh.s: 巴拉克拉瓦战役于1854年10月25日在克里米亚战争期间发生，是塞瓦斯托波尔围城战（1854—1855年）的一部分。英、法、奥斯曼盟军试图夺取俄罗斯主要黑海海军基地塞瓦斯托波尔的港口和要塞。此前，盟军于9月在阿尔马河战役中获胜；当时俄军将领缅什科夫部署军队，试图阻止盟军向南推进至战略目标。

en.s: The Thin Red Line described an episode of the Battle of Balaclava on 25 October 1854, during the Crimean War. In the incident, around 500 men of the 93rd Sutherland Highlanders led by Sir Colin Campbell, aided by a small force of 100 walking wounded, 40 detached Guardsmen, and supported by a substantial force of Turkish infantrymen, formed a line of fire against the Russian cavalry.

zh.t: “细红线”事件（巴拉克拉瓦战役）
zh.s: “细红线”是1854年10月25日克里米亚战争期间巴拉克拉瓦战役中的一段战斗。科林·坎贝尔爵士率领约500名第93萨瑟兰高地步兵团士兵，另有约100名因伤步行的士兵和40名暂时脱队的近卫军士兵协助，并得到一支规模可观的土耳其步兵部队支援。他们列成射击线，迎击俄国骑兵。

en.s: The Charge of the Light Brigade was a military action undertaken by British light cavalry against Russian forces during the Battle of Balaclava in the Crimean War, resulting in many casualties to the cavalry. On 25 October 1854, the Light Brigade, led by Lord Cardigan, mounted a frontal assault against a Russian artillery battery which was well-prepared with excellent fields of defensive fire.

zh.s: 轻骑兵冲锋是克里米亚战争期间巴拉克拉瓦战役中的一次军事行动，英国轻骑兵向俄军发起冲锋，骑兵伤亡惨重。1854年10月25日，卡迪根勋爵率领轻骑兵正面冲击俄军炮兵阵地；俄军早有准备，防御火力覆盖良好。

en.s: The First Battle of Springfield or Zagonyi's Charge was a battle of the American Civil War that occurred on October 25, 1861, in Greene County, Missouri. It was the only Union victory in southwestern Missouri in 1861.

zh.t: 第一次斯普林菲尔德战役
zh.s: 第一次斯普林菲尔德战役又称扎戈尼冲锋，是美国内战期间于1861年10月25日在密苏里州格林县发生的一场战役。这是联邦军在1861年密苏里州西南部唯一的一场胜仗。

en.s: The Battle of Pine Bluff was fought on October 25, 1863, in Pine Bluff, Arkansas, during the American Civil War. The Post of Pine Bluff, a U.S. garrison commanded by Colonel Powell Clayton, successfully defended the town against attacks led by Confederate Brigadier-General John S. Marmaduke's cavalry division. Much of the fighting took place near the Jefferson Court House, which the Confederates tried unsuccessfully to set ablaze.

zh.s: 派恩布拉夫战役于1863年10月25日在美国内战期间的阿肯色州派恩布拉夫发生。由鲍威尔·克莱顿上校指挥的美国驻军成功守住该镇，抵挡了南方邦联准将约翰·S·马尔马杜克骑兵师的进攻。双方大部分交战发生在杰斐逊法院附近，南军曾试图放火烧毁法院，但没有成功。

en.s: The Battle of Mine Creek, also known as the Battle of the Osage, was a battle that occurred on October 25, 1864, in Kansas as part of Price's Raid during the American Civil War. In the second largest cavalry engagement of the war, two divisions of Major General Sterling Price's Army of Missouri were routed by two Federal brigades under the command of Colonels Frederick Benteen and John Finis Philips. This battle was the second of three fought between Price and the Federals on this day; the first had been earlier that morning at Marais des Cygnes a few miles away, while the third would be fought a few hours later at the nearby Marmiton River.

zh.s: 米恩溪战役又称奥塞奇战役，于1864年10月25日在美国内战期间的堪萨斯州发生，是普赖斯突袭行动的一部分。这是内战中规模第二大的骑兵交战。斯特林·普赖斯少将的密苏里军团两个师遭到联邦军两个旅击溃，后者由弗雷德里克·本廷上校和约翰·菲尼斯·菲利普斯上校指挥。这是普赖斯与联邦军当天交战的三场战斗中的第二场；当天上午早些时候，双方已在数英里外的马莱德塞涅河交战，几小时后又在附近的马米顿河交战。

en.s: The Battle of Marmiton River (also known as Shiloh Creek or Charlot's Farm) occurred on October 25, 1864, in Vernon County, Missouri during the American Civil War. Following the Battle of Mine Creek, Confederate Major General Sterling Price continued his cartage towards Fort Scott. In the late afternoon of October 25, Price's supply train had difficulty crossing the Marmiton River ford and, like at Mine Creek, Price had to make a stand. Brigadier General John McNeil, commanding two brigades of Alfred Pleasonton's Union cavalry division, attacked the Confederate troops that Price and his officers had rallied, which included a sizable number of unarmed men.

zh.s: 马米顿河战役又称希洛溪战役或夏洛农场战役，于1864年10月25日在美国内战期间的密苏里州弗农县发生。米恩溪战役后，南方邦联少将斯特林·普赖斯继续向斯科特堡行军。当天傍晚，普赖斯的补给车队难以通过马米顿河渡口，他像在米恩溪战役时一样不得不停下来迎战。约翰·麦克尼尔准将率领阿尔弗雷德·普莱森顿联邦骑兵师的两个旅，袭击了普赖斯及其军官重新集结的南军，其中有不少人没有武器。

It is also called the Battle of Osage, or the Battle of Trading Post. It proved to be the first of three interconnected actions on this same day, all involving elements of Major General Sterling Price's Confederate Army of Missouri, and the Union's Provisional Cavalry Division commanded by Major General Alfred Pleasonton. zh.s: 马雷德西涅战役于1864年10月25日在堪萨斯州林恩县发生，是美国内战期间普莱斯突袭密苏里行动的一部分。此战也称奥塞奇战役或贸易站战役，是当天连续发生的三场相关战斗中的第一场。三场战斗均有斯特林·普赖斯少将率领的南方邦联密苏里军团部队，以及阿尔弗雷德·普莱森顿少将指挥的联邦临时骑兵师参加。在这场战斗中，普莱森顿的两个骑兵旅，其中一个由约翰·F.上校率领……

en.s: The Battle of Pino de Baire, also known as the Primera Carga al Machete (English: First Machete Charge), occurred on 25 October 1868 during the beginning of the Ten Years' War. It was the first instance of the reputable machete charge in the war that became a common mambí tactic.

zh.s: 皮诺德拜雷战役又称“首次砍刀冲锋”，于1868年10月25日发生在十年战争初期。这是战争中首次以砍刀冲锋的著名战例；之后砍刀冲锋成为曼比军常用战术。

en.t: The Uspenski Cathedral, designed by Aleksey Gornostayev, is inaugurated in Helsinki, Finland
en.s: Uspenski Cathedral (Finnish: Uspenskin katedraali, Swedish: Uspenskijkatedralen) is a Greek Orthodox or Eastern Orthodox cathedral in Helsinki, Finland, and main cathedral of the Orthodox Church of Finland, dedicated to the Dormition of the Theotokos (the Virgin Mary). Its name comes from the Old Church Slavonic word uspenie, which denotes the Dormition. It is the largest Orthodox church in Northern Europe.

zh.t: 赫尔辛基乌斯别斯基大教堂落成
zh.s: 乌斯别斯基大教堂（芬兰语：Uspenskin katedraali；瑞典语：Uspenskijkatedralen）是位于芬兰赫尔辛基的一座希腊正教会或东正教教堂，也是芬兰东正教会的主教座堂，供奉圣母安息。其名称来自古教会斯拉夫语“uspenie”，意为“安息”。它是北欧最大的东正教教堂。

en.s: The Battle of the Belly River was the last major conflict between the Cree (the Iron Confederacy) and the Blackfoot Confederacy, and the last major battle between First Nations on Canadian soil.

zh.s: 贝利河之战是克里族（铁联盟）与黑脚联盟之间最后一次重大冲突，也是加拿大境内第一民族之间最后一场重大战役。

en.t: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 in B♭ minor, Op. 23 premieres in Boston, Massachusetts, with Benjamin Johnson Lang as conductor and Hans von Bülow as soloist
en.s: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky ( chy-KOF-skee; 7 May 1840 – 6 November 1893) was a Russian composer of the Romantic period. He was the first Russian composer whose music made a lasting impression internationally. Tchaikovsky wrote some of the most popular concert and theatrical music in the classical repertoire, including the 1812 Overture, his First Piano Concerto, the Violin Concerto, the Romeo and Juliet Overture-Fantasy, several symphonies, the opera Eugene Onegin, and the ballets Swan Lake, The Sleeping Beauty and The Nutcracker.

zh.t: 柴可夫斯基《降B小调第一钢琴协奏曲》在波士顿首演
zh.s: 彼得·伊里奇·柴可夫斯基（1840年5月7日—1893年11月6日）是浪漫主义时期的俄罗斯作曲家，也是首位令其音乐在国际上产生持久影响的俄罗斯作曲家。他创作了古典音乐曲目中最受欢迎的一些音乐会和舞台作品，包括《1812序曲》《第一钢琴协奏曲》《小提琴协奏曲》《罗密欧与朱丽叶幻想序曲》、多部交响曲、歌剧《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》，以及芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》《睡美人》和《胡桃夹子》。

en.t: It was first performed on October 25, 1875, in Boston by Hans von Bülow after Tchaikovsky's desired pianist, Nikolai Rubinstein, criticised the piece
en.s: The Piano Concerto No. 1 in B♭ minor, Op. 23, was composed by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky between November 1874 and February 1875. It was revised in 1879 and in 1888. It was first performed on October 25, 1875, in Boston by Hans von Bülow after Tchaikovsky's desired pianist, Nikolai Rubinstein, criticised the piece. Rubinstein later withdrew his criticism and became a fervent champion of the work.

zh.t: 《降B小调第一钢琴协奏曲》首演
zh.s: 柴可夫斯基于1874年11月至1875年2月创作了《降B小调第一钢琴协奏曲》，作品编号23，后于1879年和1888年两度修订。1875年10月25日，汉斯·冯·彪罗在波士顿首次演奏此曲，此前柴可夫斯基心仪的钢琴家尼古拉·鲁宾斯坦曾批评这部作品。鲁宾斯坦后来收回批评，转而积极推广该曲。

en.s: The Shinpūren rebellion (神風連の乱, Shinpūren no ran / Jinpūren no ran) was an uprising against the Meiji government of Japan that occurred in Kumamoto on 24 October 1876. The Keishintō (敬神党), an extremist Shinto organization of former samurai of the Kumamoto Domain, were extremely opposed to the Westernization of Japan and loss of their class privileges after the Meiji Restoration.

en.s: The Jementah Civil War happened in 1879 in Jementah, Sultanate of Johor when Tengku Alam Shah, the heir of Sultan Ali of Muar refused to give the district of Muar to the temporary administration of Sultan Abu Bakar of Johor (then Maharaja in 1879). The final result of the civil war became a factor of the opening of the town of Muar. Before Sultan Abu Bakar became the ruler of Johor, Johor was ruled by Temenggong Ibrahim who was more favored than Sultan Ali. To settle the problems of administration, Sultan Ali was given the district of Muar while Temenggong Ibrahim ruled the remaining districts in Johor.

zh.s: 占曼塔内战于1879年发生在柔佛苏丹国占曼塔。当时，穆阿尔苏丹阿里的继承人腾姑·阿拉姆沙拒绝将穆阿尔县交给柔佛苏丹阿布·巴卡（当时为柔佛大君）的临时政府管理。内战最终促成穆阿尔镇开放。阿布·巴卡成为柔佛统治者之前，柔佛由敦马末·易卜拉欣统治，后者比苏丹阿里更受支持。为解决行政问题，苏丹阿里获分配穆阿尔县，敦马末·易卜拉欣则治理柔佛其余各县。

en.s: The Battle of the Shangani took place on 25 October 1893 during the First Matabele War in what is now Zimbabwe. A British South Africa Company column led by Major Patrick William Forbes was attacked during night by a large force of Ndebele Kingdom warriors. Equipped with superior weaponry, the column, consisting of British South Africa Police troopers and African auxiliaries, repulsed them with a heavy loss of life to the Ndebele force.

zh.s: 尚加尼战役于1893年10月25日在第一次马塔贝莱战争期间发生，地点位于今津巴布韦境内。帕特里克·威廉·福布斯少校率领一支英国南非公司纵队，夜间遭恩德贝莱王国大批战士袭击。纵队由英国南非警察骑兵和非洲辅助兵组成，凭借更先进的武器击退来犯者，恩德贝莱军队伤亡惨重。

en.s: The 1909 Australasian Championships was a tennis tournament that took place on outdoor grass courts at Perth Zoo, Perth, Australia from 16 October to 25 October 1909. It was the fifth edition of the Australasian Championships (now known as the Australian Open), the first held in Perth and the third Grand Slam tournament of the year. Anthony Wilding won the singles title, his second after 1906.

zh.s: 1909年澳大拉西亚锦标赛是一项网球赛事，于1909年10月16日至25日在澳大利亚珀斯动物园的室外草地球场举行。这是澳大拉西亚锦标赛（现为澳大利亚网球公开赛）第五届赛事，首次在珀斯举办，也是当年第三项大满贯赛事。安东尼·怀尔丁赢得单打冠军，这是他继1906年后第二次夺冠。

en.s: The Chinese Assassination Corps (or China Assassination Corps or Sina Assassination Corps, Chinese: 支那暗殺團; pinyin: zhīnà ànshā tuán) was an anarchist group, active in China during the final years of the Qing dynasty. One of the first organized anarchist movements in China and fiercely anti-Qing, it aimed to overthrow the then-ruling Aisin Gioro and the Empire of China through the use of revolutionary terror.
en.n: The Xinhai Revolution spreads to Guangzhou, where the Qing general Fengshan is assassinated by the Chinese Assassination Corps.

zh.s: 中国暗杀团（又称支那暗杀团；中文：支那暗殺團；拼音：zhīnà ànshā tuán）是清朝末年活跃于中国的无政府主义团体。它是中国最早的有组织无政府主义运动之一，强烈反清，意图以革命恐怖手段推翻当时执政的爱新觉罗王朝和中华帝国。

It took place between 2 September and 25 October 1916 between a joint Bulgarian–German–Ottoman force, consisting mainly of the Bulgarian Third Army, and a Romanian–Russian force. The battle was part of the Romanian campaign towards the end of 1916. It ended with a Central Powers victory.

en.s: The Battle of Aleppo was fought on 25 October 1918, when Prince Feisal's Sheifial Forces captured the city during the Pursuit to Haritan from Damascus, in the last days of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign in the First World War. en.s: The Battle off Samar was the centermost action of the Battle of Leyte Gulf, one of the largest naval battles in history, which took place in the Philippine Sea off Samar Island, in the Philippines on October 25, 1944. As the only major action in the larger battle where the Americans were largely unprepared against the opposing forces, it has been cited by historians as one of the greatest military mismatches in naval history. Adm. William Halsey, Jr. was lured into taking his powerful 3rd Fleet after a decoy fleet, leaving only three escort carrier groups of the 7th Fleet.

zh.s: 萨马岛海战是莱特湾海战的中部战斗；莱特湾海战是史上规模最大的海战之一。萨马岛海战于1944年10月25日在菲律宾萨马岛附近的菲律宾海海域进行。美军在莱特湾海战中其他主要战斗里都没有像此战这样准备不足、面对如此强大的对手，因此历史学家将其视为海战史上实力差距最大的战斗之一。威廉·哈尔西海军上将被诱使率领强大的第三舰队追击诱饵舰队，导致第七舰队只剩下三个护航航母编队。

en.s: The Battle of Guningtou (古寧頭之役), also known as the Battle of Kuningtou or the Battle of Kinmen (Chinese: 金門戰役), was fought in October 1949 on the island of Kinmen (Quemoy), located in the Taiwan Strait, during the final stages of the Chinese Civil War. en.s: Operation Sea Dragon was a series of American-led naval operations during the Vietnam War They began in October 1966 to interdict sea lines of communications and supply going south from North Vietnam to South Vietnam, and to destroy land targets with naval gunfire. Sea Dragon assets were a part of Task Force 70.8, whose mission was naval shore bombardment. The destroyers Mansfield and Hanson of the U.S Navy Seventh Fleet commenced operations on 25 October 1966 off the coast of Quang Tri Province to intercept and destroy waterborne supply craft which were attempting to carry supplies and personnel from North Vietnam to areas south of the Vietnamese Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) in South Vietnam.

zh.s: 海龙行动是越南战争期间一系列由美国主导的海军行动，始于1966年10月，旨在拦截从北越南下至南越的海上交通和补给线，并以舰炮攻击陆上目标。海龙行动的舰艇隶属第70.8特遣部队，该部队负责海岸炮击。1966年10月25日，美国海军第七舰队的“曼斯菲尔德”号和“汉森”号驱逐舰在广治省沿岸开始行动，拦截并摧毁试图将物资和人员从北越运往越南非军事区以南南越地区的水上运输船只。

en.t: Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction
en.s: The Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction or Hague Abduction Convention is a multilateral treaty that provides an expeditious method to return a child who was wrongfully taken by a parent from one country to another country. In order for the Convention to apply, both countries (the one the child was removed from, and the one the child has been brought to) must be Contracting States; i.e. both must have adopted the Convention. The Convention seeks to address international child abduction arising when a child is removed by one parent, when both parents have custody rights, or custody has yet to be determined. It was drafted to ensure the prompt return of children wrongfully abducted from their country of habitual residence, or wrongfully retained in a country that is not their country of habitual residence. The Convention was developed by the Hague Conference on Private International Law (HCCH). The convention was concluded 25 October 1980 and entered into force between the signatories on 1 December 1983.

en.t: Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections, 2010
en.s: Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) elections were held on October 25, 2010 in the Philippines. en.s: Hell in a Cell (2015) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE for the SmackDown brand. It took place on October 25, 2015, at Staples Center in Los Angeles, California. It was the seventh event under the Hell in a Cell chronology. This is also the first WWE pay-per-view, other than SummerSlam, to be held in the city of Los Angeles since 2007's No Way Out. Eight matches were contested at the event, with one match on the pre-show. In the main event, Brock Lesnar defeated The Undertaker in a Hell in a Cell match, their second such match, the first one being at No Mercy (2002).

en.s: General elections were held in Tanzania on 25 October 2015. Voters elected the president, members of Parliament, and local government councillors. Political campaigns commenced on 22 August and ceased a day before the elections.

en.s: The founding convention of the Turkish Good Party was held on 25 October 2017, on the same day as the party's establishment. Meral Akşener was declared the party's first leader unopposed, having long been established as the de facto leader of the dissident nationalist movement of politicians that had split from the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) throughout 2016.

en.s: A snap presidential election was held in Ethiopia on 25 October 2018, prompted by the resignation of incumbent Mulatu Teshome. It was the fifth presidential election of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to elect its fourth president. Diplomat Sahle-Work Zewde was elected without contest to a six-year term, becoming Ethiopia's first non-royal female head of state and the first female head of state since the death of Empress Zewditu in 1930.

zh.s: 埃塞俄比亚于2018年10月25日提前举行总统选举，起因是现任总统穆拉图·特肖梅辞职。这是埃塞俄比亚联邦民主共和国的第五次总统选举，也是该国第四任总统的选举。外交官萨赫勒-沃克·祖德成为唯一候选人，当选后将任职六年。她成为埃塞俄比亚首位非王室女性国家元首，也是自1930年祖德图女皇去世后该国首位女性国家元首。

en.s: The 2019–20 Premier League match between Southampton and Leicester City at St Mary's Stadium, Southampton, took place on Friday 25 October 2019. Leicester won the match 9–0, equalling Manchester United's 9–0 win against Ipswich Town in 1995 for the largest win in the history of the competition. en.s: The 2020 Ukrainian local elections took place on Sunday 25 October 2020. In the election, deputies of district councils and rural townships were elected and elections for city mayors were held. On 15, 22 and 29 November and 6 December 2020 a second round of mayoral elections was held in cities with more than 75,000 voters where no candidate gained more than 50% of the votes.

en.s: The 2020 Azorean regional election was held on 25 October 2020, to determine the composition of the Legislative Assembly of the Autonomous Region of the Azores. All 57 members of the assembly were up for election. The Socialist Party (PS) again won the most votes with 39 percent, but lost their majority against all predictions. en.s: The 2021 Nunavut general election was held on October 25, 2021, to return the members of the 6th Nunavut Legislature. Since the adoption of a fixed election date law in 2014, general elections in Nunavut are held in the last Monday of October in the fourth calendar year following the last elections. The Legislative Assembly of Nunavut can be dissolved earlier by the commissioner of Nunavut on the advice of the premier of Nunavut.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Puntland, a state of Somalia, on October 25, 2021, with the preliminary elections in Qardho, Eyl and Ufayn electing councils for these three districts ahead of state-wide local council elections expected to take place in early 2022. The election was the first one under the principle of one man, one vote to be held in Somalia since 1969 and the state since its formation in 1998.
